scope: Principal shop fascia only; existing Athenaeum shell, roofs, upper facade, storefront glass and awnings retained. Scheltema and station branches untouched.

assertions.part: principal shop frontage below upper windows and above striped awning
assertions.observation: Dark ATHENAEUM and BOEKHANDEL words are readable on a narrow white fascia. The fascia is subordinate to the architectural front; dark band continues around the curved corner. Separate projecting two-line white signboards are visible.
assertions.confidence: high for words, colors and fascia location; medium for photo-relative dimensions
assertions.modelTreatment: Dark ATHENAEUM BOEKHANDEL on one narrow white principal-front panel; retain the existing dark corner band. Shared uppercase bitmap glyphs simplify the photographed serif lettering. Small central emblem and projecting boards omitted.

assertions.confidence: unverified for news-shop text, not proof that the real shop has no signage
assertions.modelTreatment: Remove the unsupported name words. Do not extrapolate side text or projecting billboard geometry.

assertions.observation: Surveyed BAG footprint and native placement are retained. No measured fascia width, elevation, letter height or relief is available in the inspected sources.

priorFailure.description: Previous white ATHENAEUM letters floated y3.67..4.45775 above dark fascia y3.2..3.52 and crossed the lowest upper-window tier. NIEUWSCENTRUM was also unsupported above the dark fascia. Preserved audit remains failed evidence.

checks.method: In-memory esbuild/Three.js capture against /tmp/athenaeum-fascia-before.ts; actual shared glyph table and width fitting; complete non-sign geometry/transform/material hashes and per-glyph local +Z FrontSide ray probes. No export or generated bundle mutated.
checks.roofUpperFacadeStorefrontAndScope: All186 original non-sign meshes hash-identical; only white fascia face added. Fascia y3.2..3.52 has no vertical overlap with existing storefront panes y0.25..3.15 or first windows beginning y3.8. Existing door treatment was not redesigned.

limitations: Source page association is recorded in footprint references; photo acquisition URL, photo date and current storefront state were not independently extracted or reverified. All fascia/sign dimensions are inferred, not field measurements. GPU/browser unavailable. Front rays cover the standalone facade only and cannot establish city-context visibility, visual recognition, suppression, neighboring building retention or performance.
